# GSAP 3.12.5 + ScrollTrigger (self-hosted, pinned)

Source: cdnjs.cloudflare.com (official GSAP CDN mirror), version 3.12.5 —
`gsap.min.js` and `ScrollTrigger.min.js`.

License: GreenSock "Standard No Charge" license — free for this kind of
use (including the ScrollTrigger plugin, which became free for everyone
in the 2024 GSAP license change; previously a paid "Business Green"
plugin). Full terms: https://gsap.com/standard-license — no new paid
service or subscription was added to source these files.

Loaded only through an import map entry, following the same self-hosted,
versioned pattern as `vendor/three`. A new release goes in a new
version-numbered folder; never edit a file here in place.
